summary: Palestinian/local sources and OCHA reported that settlers threw incendiary material/Molotov cocktails at Ahmad Maher Awashra's family home, setting it on fire while six family members were inside; an Israeli police inspection was separately reported as finding an electrical fault rather than arson.
discovery_sources: OCHA 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA 26 Mar 2023; NAD March 2023; ITIC citing Israeli police inspection
resolution_notes: Do not promote while cause/perpetrator evidence conflicts. OCHA, WAFA and NAD preserve the settler-arson allegation, but ITIC reports that an Israeli police inspection concluded the blaze resulted from an electrical fault, not arson. Incident fact (house fire) is clear; political-violence attribution is not. Preserve both accounts and seek the underlying police/fire report or a later official/court finding before resolution.
media_status: Exact same-event aftermath imagery exists in WAFA/AFP/photographer coverage, but it is not proof of perpetrator identity and no canonical media card is published while scope attribution remains unresolved.
